appraisal_events.evidence: Swann ... allait jusqu'à proclamer que Mme Verdurin était une grande âme. ... Ce sont des êtres magnanimes ... Je t'assure qu'elle m'a donné les preuves d'une noblesse de coeur, d'une hauteur d'âme.
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann extravagantly praises Mme Verdurin as magnanimous and noble-hearted, but the narrator frames this as gratitude and self-interest infiltrating his judgment rather than an objective truth, undercutting the praise.

appraisal_events.evidence: un « nouveau » ... sur lequel ils fondaient beaucoup d'espoir, le comte de Forcheville ... le premier dîner ... mit en lumière toutes ces différences, fit ressortir ses qualités et précipita la disgrâce de Swann.
appraisal_events.explanation: The Verdurins pin hopes on Forcheville as a promising new recruit, and his first dinner makes his 'qualities' stand out favorably against Swann's reserve—though the narrator makes clear these 'qualities' are really an uncritical enthusiasm and poor taste that simply fit the milieu better.

appraisal_events.evidence: Il se trouva qu'il était justement le beau-frère de Saniette, ce qui remplit d'étonnement les fidèles : le vieil archiviste avait des manières si humbles qu'ils l'avaient toujours cru d'un rang social inférieur au leur et ne s'attendaient pas à apprendre qu'il appartenait à un monde riche et relativement aristocratique.
appraisal_events.explanation: The fidèles are startled to learn that Saniette, whom they had assumed to be of modest rank because of his humble manner, is in fact connected through Forcheville to a wealthy, relatively aristocratic world.

status_effects.explanation: Swann's lavish praise elevates her within his own view, but the narrator's framing of this praise as self-serving keeps the effect modest and unreliable.
Forcheville rises clearly in the Verdurins' favor, hoped for and then confirmed as a good fit for the milieu, in direct contrast to Swann's concurrent fall.
The revelation of his aristocratic connection modestly raises his perceived standing among the fidèles, though it is a passive discovery rather than an action of his own.
